# Jubilees Chapter 45 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 45:3 — "bowed upon the head of his bed" vs. "bowed his head on the headrest"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he bowed upon the head of his bed and died" | Literal Ge'ez spatial phrase |
| LOGOS | "he bowed his head on the headrest of his bed" | Clarifies the action anatomically |
| PNEUMA | "he leaned back his head and died" | Dynamic; loses the "bowing" connotation of worship |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "bowed his head on the headrest." The Ge'ez gesture has connotations of worship (cf. Genesis 47:31 — Jacob "bowed in worship"). PNEUMA's "leaned back" loses this sense. LOGOS preserves both the gesture and the object.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 45:11 — Abel Mizraim etymology

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "meadow of Egypt" | Literal rendering of 'abel + mitzraim |
| LOGOS | "meadow of mourning for Egypt" | Adds "mourning" to capture the 'abel ambiguity (meadow/mourning) |
| PNEUMA | "The Meadow of Egyptian Mourning" | Same as LOGOS but reorganized |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS partial — "Abel Mizraim" preserved as the place name, with the parenthetical gloss dropped. The ambiguity between 'abel "meadow" and 'abel "mourning" is present in Hebrew/Ge'ez but either is valid. The place name stands for itself.

**Status:** Resolved: place name preserved without full gloss.
